verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's own docs say its GitHub, Linear and Jira integrations create HumanLayer tasks directly from issues or tickets. Those tasks are the unit that runs agent coding sessions, and work is linked back to the source issue (Linear also syncs status). missing for 10: step-by-step documentation of the issue-to-agent assignment flow (trigger, configuration, which agent picks it up), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket

citations.quote: Connect GitHub to create HumanLayer tasks from issues and link task artifacts back to the source issue.
Connect Linear so HumanLayer can create tasks from Linear issues, sync issue status, and link HumanLayer artifacts back to the source issue.
Connect Jira Cloud so HumanLayer can create tasks from Jira tickets and keep ticket-driven agent work connected to its source.
A HumanLayer task gives one piece of work: A group of related sessions
